name: Dumbbell Cross-Body Hammer Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell beside each hip and your thumbs pointing forward.
Bend one elbow and draw the dumbbell diagonally toward your opposite shoulder with your thumb uppermost.
Lower the dumbbell to the same hip and alternate arms.
tips: Keep your torso facing straight ahead.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid swinging your shoulders to heave the dumbbell across.
